description.stringValue:
PUNARJJANI – The Pratheeksha Reborn is a charity management web application developed using Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and RxJS. The platform was designed to digitally manage multiple social welfare activities including blood donation, hair donation, medicine support, and birthday donations through a single system.
The application contains dedicated modules such as Blood Wing, Hair to Care, Drug Wing, and Gift of Giving. Users can register as blood or hair donors, submit medicine support requests, and make birthday donations with details like PAN card number, donation date, email, and contact information.
An integrated Admin Panel allows administrators to manage donor records, patient requests, and donation details efficiently. The project uses Angular services and local storage for dynamic data handling and persistence.
The application features responsive UI design, reusable Angular components, form validation, routing, and real-time data updates using RxJS BehaviorSubjects.
